Commentary.Commentary: The pitch appears to a be true one for batting and Bangladesh will be backing themselves to scale down this target. However, the Afghan bowling has a lot of class and they will try their best to restrict the home side. Who will succeed? Do join us in a short while to find out.

Afghan is down for an interview. On asked about the first six overs, he says they were poor for them as they played rash shots to get out. On Nabi's performance, Afghan replies that Nabi is the senior player and he has done justice with that responsibility. On him getting out on a no ball, Afghan smiles and states that he was lucky there. Believes that the total is good enough and that they can defend it.

42 runs in the last 3 overs and Afghanistan have got a big finish! They were in an early spot of bother after losing four wickets inside the Powerplay but then the 79-run stand between Nabi and Afghan did the rescue job. Their partnership deflated the Bangladesh bowlers and they went haywire. Runs started to come at a brisk rate and Afghanistan managed to run away with a strong total on the board. Mohammad Saifuddin and Shakib Al Hasan were the standout bowlers while Mustafizur Rahman was very tidy. The rest didn't manage to leave the same impact though.

DROPPED! Fullish and around off, Janat has to go for it and tries powering it down the ground. But he fails to get any timing on it and the ball skies up towards mid on. Mustafizur runs back to take the catch but fails to hold on. The batsmen take a run and AFGHANISTAN END ON 164/6!
Short in length on middle, this time Nabi gets bat on ball and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
This is spectacular bowling. Slower cutter, on the shorter side around leg, Nabi swings his bat but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
The Fizz bowls another clever delivery. Short and on middle and leg, a slower one, Nabi mistimes his shot towards mid off. Turns down the single.
Short in length and outside off, Karim slaps it to backward point and scampers to the other end. Nabi is back on strike. 17 runs needed and 4 balls left, can Nabi do it and get his century?
Swing and a miss! Clever slower one by the Fizz. It's short and around middle, cutting away, Janat is early into the swing of his bat and misses.

SIX! In the slot and Nabi takes full toll of it. Into the 80s is Nabi with this massive six. Nabi clears front leg and lifts it straight over the long off fence. Some hammering this for Saifuddin, the star bowler of the evening for the hosts.
Fuller one on off this time, worked towards mid off for a quick single.
Good length ball around off, Nabi finds the long off fielder on bounce with his uppish drive.
Good comeback! Bowls a superb yorker. Nabi can't do much about it as he looks to jam it out but can't get bat on ball.
SIX! Nabi is in some mood. He isn't deceived by the slower ball. Reads it well and lifts it over the long on fence.
Fuller one around off, Nabi mistimes the shot and the ball goes towards long on. It should've been just a single but Nabi is quick to get back for a couple He wants to keep the strike.
Good length around off, Nabi looks to heave it over the long off fence but is beaten. He gets a free hit next up as Saifuddin has overstepped.
Slower short ball on off, Nabi pulls it down to long on and retains strike with a single. 22 from the over, a humongous one!
FOUR! Sarkar has completely lost the plot here. Short in length and outside off, Nabi gets on top of the bounce and smashes it over backward point for a cracking boundary.
SIX! Nabi is on fire! A pitched up ball around off, Nabi found that in his hitting zone and clobbers it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Sarkar misses his mark there. Tries a yorker but it's down the leg side, Nabi gets a fine tickle on it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
SIX! Out of here! Nabi fetches a short delivery from wide outside off and hammers it over cow corner for a maximum.
Goes on the back foot and punches it past extra cover for a run.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single. Two wickets and just one run. Sensational stuff from Saifuddin.

OUT! Stumps shattered and Saifuddin is on fire! He hurls in a length ball around off, shaping back in, Naib stays back to heave it across the line but misses the ball completely. The stumps are disturbed and Afghanistan lose their sixth wicket.
Fuller ball on off, pushed towards cover.
Shortish and on middle, pulled down to fine leg for one.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Nabi tries flicking but misses.
Gulbadin Naib walks in next. He can certainly tonk a few.

OUT! A 3-wicket haul for Saifuddin, this is now his best bowling figures in T20Is. A knuckle delivery, on a length outside off, Afghan aims for a big shot down the ground but fails to middle his shot properly. Completely deceived by the variation and gets more height than distance. A simple catch for Sabbir after coming in a bit from long on. The 79-run stand has been broken and it's a timely breakthrough for Bangladesh.
Gets away with a bad one! Full toss on middle and leg, Asghar swings and misses to get hit on the pads.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back to bowl at the death. He was brilliant in the Powerplay where he picked up a couple of wickets.
Fullish and on off, driven down the ground but straight to mid off. Dot ball to complete the over, 10 from it.
Edgy! Slower short delivery wide outside off, angling away, Asghar throws his bat at it and bottom edges it again. It falls short of Rahim who parries it to short third man. They cross.
Mishit! Short in length and outside off, Asghar tries to pull but it takes the bottom edge and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
A well-directed short ball, Nabi bends a bit and helps his pull to long leg for a run.
Short in length and on middle, Nabi stands tall and pulls it wide of short fine leg. The square leg fielder cuts it off and they take a brace.
SIX! Bang! Fullish and on middle and off, Nabi removes his front leg from the line of the delivery and smokes it over long on for a maximum.
Flatter one around off this time, tucked towards long on by Nabi for a single. 16 runs from the over.
SIX! Poor ball and it has got the treatment it deserved. Banged short on middle, Nabi swivels and pulls it way over the fence for another maximum.
On middle, Nabi pushes it straight to the bowler.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. They pick up a single.
SIX! Flighted and full outside off, Asghar dances down the track and towers it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Time to punish the Bangla bowlers.
Goes on the back foot and punches it back past the bowler. Only a run from the Free Hit.

Afghan departs! Or has he? They're checking the front foot no ball and it looks like this is a no ball. Yes! Wicket on a no ball which means Afghan will face a Free Hit delivery now. Darts one on middle, Afghan dances down the track and lifts it high in the air. The timing is not proper and the deep mid-wicket fielder pouches it. But in the end, it doesn't matter as Taijul has overstepped.
Taijul returns into the attack.
Play and a miss! Flighted ball around off, Nabi looks to drive it by staying in the crease but the away spin means he can't get bat on ball. A very tight over this from Mahmudullah.
Quicker one around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller on the pads, tucked towards mid on for a single this time.
No timing on that one. This was around off on a shortish length, Nabi wanted to hammer it over the mid-wicket fence but mistimed it. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads this time, pushed through mid-wicket gently for a single. Wanted a couple but the deep fielder did well to keep it to one.
Shortish ball around off, pushed straight to point.
Mahmudullah is the seventh bowler to bowl in this innings.
Shortish one this time, Afghan taps it towards point for single. 50-run stand is up between the two. End of a top spell from Shakib. Just 18 runs off his 4 and a couple of wickets.
Quicker one on the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Fuller around off this time, Nabi looks to work it down the leg side but gets a leading edge and the ball goes to cover.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter one around off, tapped towards point for a single this time.
FOUR! Top shot! Shakib dishes a fuller ball around the pads of Afghan, he comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Landed just ahead of the ropes.
Shakib is back on to bowl his final over. 3-1-11-2, so far.
Flatter one on the pads, Nabi works it towards square leg and takes a quick couple. Good running.
Fuller one around off, pushed towards point for single.
SIX! Hammered! Afghan is not going to miss out on these. Flatter one on middle, Afghan dances down the track and powers it over the long on fence for a maximum. Momentum with Afghanistan now.
Flatter one on the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Another one on the pads, Afghan tucks it towards square leg and takes a run.
Darts one on shortish length Nabi works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowling change. Mosaddek Hossain is introduced into the attack for the first time.
Flighted and on middle, Nabi turns it in the gap at mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. But this is all he will get. 11 from the over, this stand has moved to 31 off 31 balls.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to the over. Taijul dives to his left and parries it towards covers.
SIX! Dismissed! Taijul delivers an arm ball on middle and it's on the shorter side. Nabi goes deep inside the crease and pulls it enormously over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Advances down the track for a big shot but fails to middle it properly. It runs down to wide long on and the batsmen get another couple in this over.
A flatter one, short and on off, it's punched back to the off side and the bowler makes a stop.
Good cricket from Nabi. He just tucks it with soft hands in front of square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Good length ball outside off, cut away for a single through point. 60/4 at the halfway mark!
Fuller around off, looks to guide through third man but finds the fielder.

Good thinking from Soumya but the umpire calls it a wide. Sarkar saw Afghan advancing and banged one short outside off. Asghar is too far down the track and can't do anything but allow the ball to go to the keeper. Mushfiqur behind the wickets can't gather it cleanly and allows a bye. However, it was too high and called a wide. Good decision from the umpire.
Good length ball outside off, pushed through point for a single.
FOUR! On the pads this time. Nabi is not going to miss out on this one. He flicks it off his toes through the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Slightly fuller around off, Afghan taps it towards point and takes a quick run.

Down the leg side, Afghan tucks it towards short fine leg. He calls for a single but is sent back. Good call as Mustafizur fires a throw at the striker's end and Afghan just about plonks his bat in at the last moment! It is referred upstairs and replays confirm.
Soumya Sarkar into the attack now.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Huge LBW shout. Turned down. Impact outside off. Nabi got across to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.

LUCKY! Full and outside off, Afghan looks to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. The ball lobs in the air and goes behind. Mustafizur Rahman gets across from short third man but cannot quite get to the chance. Stops on the bounce and a single is taken.
Full and around middle, pushed towards the bowler.
A touch short, around middle, Nabi tucks it towards the leg side and scampers through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Angling in around middle and off, Asghar defends it from the crease.
Slightly short and on middle, angling in, Nabi taps it down to mid-wicket and steals a run.
Rahman switches to 'round the wicket and bowls it on a length outside off, Afghan steers it wide of point and takes one.
Short and wide outside off, Afghan slaps it behind backward point and collects a couple of runs.
Pitches it up and around off, Nabi tries driving down the ground but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls beside the pitch and the batsmen take one.
Angling away from the batsman, on a good length, Nabi pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Change of ends for Mustafizur Rahman.
Short in length on off, Nabi hangs back and forces it to sweeper cover for one.
Quicker and shorter on off, stroked off the back foot but straight to covers.
Gently pushes a full ball towards covers and rotates the strike.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes on the back foot and punches it past the bowler to long on for one.
Flighted and on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Taijul Islam is into the attack now.
Nabi drags it across the line, over square leg and picks up a run. 41/4 in the Powerplay!
Mohammad Nabi walks in next with Afghanistan reeling.

OUT! Afghanistan lose their fourth wicket inside the Powerplay. Shakib picks a wicket with an arm ball now. He dishes it out wide outside off and Zadran has to reach out for it in order to play his big shot. He does so but fails to hit it from the sweet spot. The ball gathers the lower half of his bat and balloons towards mid off. Sarkar runs back and grabs the skier safely. No heroics from Zadran today.
On middle, helped on the leg side but not in the gap.
FOUR! Connects and connects well. Arm ball again, it's on the pads and Najibullah bisects the two fielders square on the leg side for a boundary. Nothing that short fine leg or square leg could do.
Skidding away again, from around off, Zadran reverse sweeps but finds short third man.
Wide! Shakib fires a full ball down the leg side, Zadran swings his bat and misses.
Arm ball on off, skidding in, Afghan gets back and punches it to covers for a quick run.

Well bowled! Fuller in length and angling in around off, Zadran tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It takes the leading edge and goes towards cover-point. Decent beginning by Rahman!
Wide called for height! A slower bouncer, goes well over the batsman who leaves it alone. Rahim fails to collect and the batsmen switch ends.
Mid on and mid off drop back.
FOUR! Bludgeoned down the ground. Again Asghar clears his front leg, finds the delivery on a length and in his half just outside off and he whacks it over mid on for a boundary.
A bit short and on off, Afghan clears his front leg and punches it through the line. Finds the cover fielder.
Short in length around middle, Asghar tries to pull but misses. It goes off his right arm to point.
Shortish and outside off, Zadran guides it behind square on the off side for one. He is off the mark.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Zadran helps it to short fine leg where the fielder fumbles a bit but no run is conceded.
Mustafizur Rahman is introduced into the attack. He is one short of 50 wickets in this format of the game.

FOUR BYES! Another one that beats the bat, stumps and the keeper. Second time it has happened in as many overs from Shakib. Arm ball on middle, skidding down, Afghan hops back before swinging his bat but is beaten comprehensively. The ball races behind and meets the fence.
Shortish on off, punched from the back foot but straight to extra cover.
Fires in an arm ball on middle and leg, Afghan moves back to work it around but misses and is hit on the pads.
Nearly a drag on! A touch short and on off, an arm ball, Afghan tries to cut close to his body and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Up and over the bowler's head. Flighted and on off, Afghan goes aerial and muscles it over Shakib. The mid off fielder stands no chance as it races away to the fence.
Quicker and flatter one on off, defended off the back foot.
Najibullah Zadran arrives in the middle. He is fresh from a cracking knock against Zimbabwe last evening.

OUT! Wicket number 3 goes down! Tarakai hits a biggie and falls on the next ball attempting almost a similar shot. Saifuddin serves a shortish ball on off and Najeeb goes back to power his pull shot over the fence. But he fails to pack it with enough power and Sabbir takes a simple catch at deep square leg.
SIX! What a great shot! Just a clip and it went like a rocket! Fuller and on middle, Tarakai swings his bat across the line and sends it packing over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fullish and angling in on middle, Tarakai pushes it down towards mid on. Sarkar makes a fine stop running across to his left from mid-wicket.
A touch short in length and on off, Asghar gives the charge and this time he drags his shot off the inside half. The ball travels to deep square leg and they take a run.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Tarakai drags his pull shot through square leg and picks up a single.
A length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Asghar fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. They take a leg bye.
Loopy and full on ff, Najeeb pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter on off, Tarakai punches it past the bowler to mid on.
Asghar Afghan is the new batsman.

OUT! Zazai holes out! Shakib bowls a flighted full ball on middle, Zazai kneels to slog it across the line but fails to middle his shot properly. It skies up in the air and Liton at deep mid-wicket catches it with his fingers pointing up. Sorry start for Afghanistan as both their openers are dismissed cheaply.
Tries to defend again but misses. It goes off his pads to point and they steal a run. Mustafizur has a shy at the striker's end but misses. What is Mustafizur doing at point?
Flighted and full on off, it's defended off the front foot.

FOUR BYES! That missed everything. Shakib delivers an arm ball around middle and it skids on after pitching. Tarakai tries to heave it over the leg side but misses. It goes past the inside edge of his bat and the keeper also fails to collect it. The short fine leg fielder gives the chase but comes second best.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Fullish and on off, it's forced down the ground to long on for a run. End of a fine first over by Saifuddin.
Third man comes up, mid on drops back...
A length ball landing outside off and angles back into the batsman, Tarakai defends it off his back foot.
Saifuddin eyes a yorker but ends up serving a low full toss on middle and off, Zazai works it in front of square leg for a run.
Najeeb wants to sighters! He is just going after everything. Gets width outside off and just throws his bat at that one. It flies off the outer half and drops safely behind point. They take a run.

Lovely shot! Fuller in length and around off, Najeeb heaves it over mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs to open his and Afghanistan's account. Sabbir with a nice footwork stopped the ball near the fence.
Najeeb Tarakai is the new batsman.

OUT! Off stump goes for an early walk! What a splendid delivery first up by Saifuddin. He hurls in a length ball in the line of the stumps and gets it to nip away a shade. Gurbaz is on the back foot attempting to work it around but is beaten by the movement. The off stump goes cartwheeling and the Bangla crowd lets out a big roar. Perfect start!

We're all in readiness to get underway. Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz are the Afghan openers. They took Afghanistan to a flying start yesterday and would like to repeat the good work again. Mohammad Saifuddin to kick off proceedings. A slip in place along with a short third man. Here we go...

Bangladesh skipper, Shakib Al Hasan wanted to bat first but now want to bowl well and restrict Afghanistan. Adds that they have taken a lot of confidence from the last game but is aware of the challenge that Afghanistan brings. Praises Afif for his knock and wants the batters to take more responsibility. No change in the XI, he informs.

Afghanistan skipper, Rashid Khan says that his batting department is looking in great form and is hoping for a similar performance today as well. Tells that they take one game at a time and will give their 100 percent. Feels that they have enough ability in the team and have the batsmen who can hit big. Wants to keep the focus and do the right thing at the right time. Informs that they are going unchanged.

Pitch report - The pitch looks really good, very similar to the last night. It has a bit of grass cover on the top and it's really hard underneath. A few cracks as well to keep the spinners interested.

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Liton Das, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan(C), Mushfiqur Rahim(WK), Mahmudullah, Sabbir Rahman, Mosaddek Hossain, Afif Hossain, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taijul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.

Afghanistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Hazratullah Zazai, Rahmanullah Gurbaz(WK), Najeeb Tarakai, Najibullah Zadran, Asghar Afghan, Mohammad Nabi, Gulbadin Naib, Rashid Khan(C), Karim Janat, Fareed Ahmed, Mujeeb Ur Rahman.

TOSS - Rashid Khan has won the coin-flip and AFGHANISTAN WILL BAT! Something different from a captain. So far, in the last two games, teams have preferred chasing. Anyway, the Afghans put up a strong batting show last time and are once again banking on their batters. Bangladesh won't mind chasing again. They would have drawn a lot of confidence from a close chase against Zimbabwe. BOTH TEAMS ARE UNCHANGED!

Hello, folks. This tri-series is moving at a rapid rate and so far it has been expected results. Zimbabwe have got beaten by both Bangladesh and Afghanistan, however, the Rhodesians presented a stiff competition in front of the home team. Now, it's time for the big clash, clash of the favourites. The Afghans are on a high post their Test triumph and then eased past the African minnow in their first game. They have a nicely balanced squad filled with multiple utility T20 players while the Bangla Tigers own a more experienced squad. On current form and momentum, Afghanistan seem to be holding the edge but a hurt Bangladesh would like to send across a strong message with a thumping win. Expect a cracker!
